problem_statement: Let Gamma be Z/2 * Z/2 * Z/2 with standard involutive generators and let X be the Polish product space 2^Gamma with the shift action. Let G_exp be the fixed 3-regular acyclic Borel graphing obtained on the free part by decorating Schreier neighborhoods with a fixed high-girth expander sequence of girth at least 7 and uniform spectral gap following the Bowen-Qian-Weilacher Ramsey-expander template at fixed parameters. Determine its Borel chromatic number and whether the Marks determinacy-game obstruction transfers to a LOCAL lower bound.
record_title: Borel 3-Colorability Versus LOCAL Lower Bounds on an Expander-Decorated 3-Regular Graphing
